# xrpl-muse-skill

> Trade the XRP Ledger from the terminal with a hard safety boundary
> between proposing a trade and signing it. Built for AI agents; safe
> for humans. Read-only by default — every market read works keyless,
> signing requires an explicit typed ceremony. MIT licensed.

Repo: https://github.com/terramike/xrpl-muse-skill

## Entry points

- `README.md` — install, quick start, command map, what's new
- `SKILL.md` — the full operator manual (architecture, every command,
  policy model, NFT flows)
- `SECURITY.md` — the safety model and its limits
- `AGENTS.md` — contributor guidance: tests, conventions, what never
  to touch
- `references/` — deep docs per topic: `onboarding-wizard.md`,
  `ecosystem-connectors.md`, `trusted-links.md` (verified-link registry),
  `fuzzy-lore.md`
- `bin/xrpl-trade` — the proposer CLI (builds txs, never signs)
- `bin/xrpl-sign` — the policy-gated signer (only program that sees a seed)
- `bin/xrpl_eco.py` — ecosystem read modules (validators, amendments,
  stablecoin, oracle)

## Safety invariants (do not work around these)

1. Fresh installs are read-only. `xrpl-trade live` requires typing
   `go live` at an interactive prompt — there is deliberately no CLI
   flag or env var to skip it.
2. `xrpl-trade` never sees a seed and never submits. `xrpl-sign` only
   signs a hash-bound proposal envelope the human approved exactly.
3. Never request, reveal, or record a seed. Ever.
4. Network reads fail open (clear "unavailable", never fabricated data);
   external data is always attributed, never presented as ledger truth.

## Quick commands (all keyless reads)

```bash
xrpl-trade validators        # signed validator-list health
xrpl-trade amendments         # amendment votes + majority countdown
xrpl-trade stablecoin RLUSD   # supply by chain + price
xrpl-trade oracle XRP USD     # on-ledger XLS-47 prices (Band + DIA)
xrpl-trade token-safety --help
xrpl-trade trace rABC... [--depth 2]         # funding-origin chain
xrpl-trade links rABC... rDEF... [--window 200]  # shared counterparties
xrpl-trade flow rABC... [--window 200]          # top counterparties by volume
xrpl-trade nft-trail 00081F...                  # NFT mint -> sale provenance
xrpl-trade token-trail --issuer r... --currency USD  # issuer + holders + issuer-involved movers
xrpl-trade <command> --help   # every command documents itself
```

## Propose → approve → sign (needs human approval)

```bash
xrpl-trade buy --pair XRP/RLUSD --amount 10 --price 1.50  # proposal + hash
xrpl-sign --profile main --approve <hash>                 # human signs
```

## Tests

```bash
python3 -m unittest tests.test_readonly
python3 -m unittest tests.test_eco
```
